name: rule-develop-any-slug-another-run
why: The same rule, against another run's ask: the class holds each box's own branch.

job.purpose: Deliver a change as a pull request from branch discobox/<slug> into main of discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch (creating it with an empty --force-with-lease, and with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update the pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or any other branch, delete a branch, merge or close the pull request, delete a comment, or start any other workflow.
